gen-gf-goldman-general-sans: Goldman spreads its wide, round letters out with generous clearance, and its lowercase stands tall against the capitals. General Sans keeps one steady line.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-public-sans: Chunky and loud, Grandstander pours its letters at a single width with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Public Sans then settles in beside it, broad and open.
gen-orbitron-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans stands up sturdy and tall. Orbitron stretches its letters far apart with big, open eyes, so the two feel like opposite ends of a ruler.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads curvy and loose, with tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips on a wire-thin skeleton. Press Start 2P sits above it, pinned and playful.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-merriweather-sans: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P pins its big-bowled letters far apart, with only a faint modulation up close. Merriweather Sans is the sturdy, tall-lowercase one.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-satoshi: Satoshi reads soaring and open, its x-height tall and its e never squeezed shut, every stroke cut to one width. Love Ya Like A Sister sits above it, low-ascendered and bold, with terminals pointing outward.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-manrope: Manrope reads bright and open, each curved letter showing a clear gap at its mouth and a pen line that never changes width. Early GameBoy stretches out above it, wide and playful.
gen-righteous-fs-fira-sans: Righteous fills the line with big bowls, like thin steel rod bent into letters. Fira Sans is the quieter half, with a tall x-height, s curves open at both ends and no stroke contrast.
gen-righteous-fs-merriweather-sans: Bowls that fill the whole line give Righteous its punch. Merriweather Sans backs it up with sturdy, tall lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, which keeps the page easy to follow.
gen-tourney-fs-public-sans: Athletic and bold, Tourney stretches wide tracking over letters bent from a single wire. Public Sans follows with a hefty lowercase and broad open counters, so paragraphs stay steady and easy on the eye.
